Syllabus (official plan, Advt 04/2026)

The board has published the paper plan for Advt 04/2026:

PartSectionMarks (approx.)
AMatric-level Punjabi - Gurus' lives and writings, synonyms and antonyms, idioms, proverbs, prefixes and suffixes, gender and number, punctuation, correct spellings, Punjabi forms of English words, numbers, months and days, Punjab history and culture50 (qualifying, 25 needed, no negative)
BGeneral knowledge and current affairs - polity, environment, science and technology, economy, Indian freedom struggle, sports, cinema and literature, geography25
BLogical reasoning and mental ability (17), basic numeracy (4), data from charts and tables (4)25
BPunjab history and culture - physical features, ancient history, Bhakti and Sufi movements, Sikh Gurus, Adi Granth, Sikh rulers, freedom movements17
BPunjabi grammar13
BEnglish grammar12
BICT - computer basics, network and internet, Word, Excel, PowerPoint8
Part B total (merit)100
  • Time: 2 hours 30 minutes, MCQ on OMR sheet; 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer in Part B.
  • Reasoning and GK together are half the merit paper; Punjab history alone is 17 marks - more than English.
